Bug_Title: UR: Uninitialized read of field in constructor (UR_UNINIT_READ)
Bug_Details:
This constructor reads a field which has not yet been assigned a value. 
This is often caused when the programmer mistakenly uses the field instead
of one of the constructor's parameters.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the constructor where the field 'value' is read before it is assigned a value. This uninitialized read can lead to unpredictable behavior as the value of 'value' is indeterminate at that point.
Trigger_Explanation: The test triggers the bug by creating an instance of UninitializedReadBug with the parameter 10. Inside the constructor, the field 'value' is printed before it is initialized, leading to an uninitialized read.
